[[File:Gwanda_gourd.jpg|250px|thumb|Gwand gourds on Endor]]
'''Gwanda gourds''' could be found growing on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The gourds varied in shades of blue, pink, and purple and had a lumpy, bumpy texture. Gwanda gourds, according to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], made the best rattles for the great [[Wistie Dance]] at the [[Festival of the Wisties]].

In preparation for one particular festival, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] retrieved a gourd for the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]].
